ResearchProjectDef.label: cryostrike module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech animal implant that can be installed onto the spine or any compatible artificial spine replacement. The module comes with a set of advanced artificial micro-organs that produce a cryogenic venom-like substance that has a high likelihood of causing hypothermia in any being it comes in contact with. The substance gathers around the body parts that its host uses for combat, allowing it to be injected into or launched at its target with each bite, scratch or strike.

ResearchProjectDef.label: leathermaker module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. This implant model refines excess nutrients and typically indigestible biological material, repurposing it to cultivate patches of leather or fur using the host's cells. Once a sufficient mass has developed, the cultivated biomaterial can be safely and painlessly removed. Despite being originally designed as an alternative to traditional fur farms, the technology is compatible with the physiology of nearly all animal species, including humans. The amount of leather produced depends on the amount of food consumed by its host.

ResearchProjectDef.label: magstrike module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech animal implant that can be installed onto the spine or any compatible artificial spine replacement. The module comes with a set of advanced artificial micro-organs that are capable of emitting short-ranged directional electromagnetic pulses. The EMP disturbances are emitted upon performing a melee attack, allowing its host to stun mechanoids and halt the functionality of electronic equipment with each bite, scratch or strike.

ResearchProjectDef.label: meatmaker module
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed into a stomach or any compatible artificial stomach replacement. This implant model refines excess nutrients and typically indigestible biological material, repurposing it to cultivate clumps of meat using the host's cells. Once a sufficient mass has developed, the cultivated biomaterial can be safely and painlessly removed. Despite being originally designed as an alternative to traditional raising of livestock, the technology is compatible with the physiology of nearly all animal species, including humans. The amount of meat produced depends on the amount of food consumed by its host.

ResearchProjectDef.label: monoslash tail module
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a high-tech device that can be installed onto any tail or compatible tail replacement. The module is equipped with a retractable plasteel blade along with various skeletal and muscle enhancements that allows an animal to use it in combat as if it were an additional limb regardless of how unfit for fighting its natural tail may be.
It has been enhanced using mono weapon components, resulting in combat performance and effectiveness comparable to that of a monosword.
